site_name: Land North of Buckmore Farm, Petersfield
evidence_slice: South Downs National Park Authority's Planning Committee page for 9 October 2025 lists application SDNP/24/03588/REM for Land North of Buckmore Farm, Petersfield. The Authority's 4 June 2026 delivery update states that reserved matters approval has been granted for 85 new homes at Buckmore Farm on a locally allocated Petersfield Neighbourhood Plan site, that the developer is progressing construction, and that 39 dwellings (45%) will be affordable. The Authority-hosted Local Plan Service exposes layer 13 named Housing Site Allocation as an esriGeometryPolygon layer in British National Grid EPSG:27700.
